newsitem.title: UK: Bioscience Innovation Centre plans AIM float.
newsitem.headline: Bioscience Innovation Centre plans AIM float.

text.p: Bioscience Innovation Centre Plc, a developer of bioscience businesses, said on Monday it plans to float on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) via a placing and offer raising 6.0 million stg.
BIC will use the proceeds from the issue to build a purpose-built 20,000 sq ft headquarters in Cambridge. The float will also provide working capital.

The company said it plans to identify promising bioscience businesses and provide them with business services. BIC may also take equity stakes in its client companies. The broker and adviser to the issue is Teather and Greenwood.
